# Cncf Sighup Distribution Reviewer

Review SIGHUP Distribution using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. SIGHUP Distribution is a battle-tested distribution purely based on upstream Kubernetes. Deploy and manage a stable and production grade Kubernetes Cluster at scale with a comprehensive Cloud Native stack implemented with top notch CNCF components.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
